results.device_name: Filler, Recombinant Human Bone Morphogenetic Protein, Collagen Scaffold, Osteoinduction - Hde, Long Bone Nonunion
results.definition: Bone graft substitute when autograft is unavailable or unfeasible to harvest for treatment of recalcitrant long bone non-unions where normal bone metabolism and healing is not present, e.g., smokers and diabetics.
